body:
ACCEPT all three repairs.

1. C1-A will not construct checked SourceBundle or final BundleId. It owns source/edition/stream primitives, exact axes, final stream/axis identities, and a structurally checked SourceManifest[UnresolvedMappings] with local manifest keys. It is not usable as resolved source evidence. C1-C validates ClockRepair relations; C1-D validates TrackComposition and EditionCorrespondence, resolves every local mapping reference, and only then constructs checked SourceBundle plus final BundleId/EditionId from the complete canonically ordered manifest. Any mapping relation change, gap, occurrence, epoch, seam, direction, family, endpoint, or rendition change therefore changes identity or refuses.

2. C1-C's total outcome includes Exact, Quantized, Enclosing, Gap, OutsideDomain, NoCorrespondence, Ambiguous, and Refused. C1-C owns shared mapping laws: directed source/target axes and family; relation identity versus derivation receipt; occurrence; epoch/discontinuity seams; endpoint semantics; canonical coalescing; overflow/rounding; and ClockRepair monotonicity only within an epoch. C1-D adds TrackComposition-specific repeat/reorder/hold/gap/set-valued reverse laws and EditionCorrespondence's evidential/no-coordinate-cast laws.

3. C1-E owns three non-convertible families: stream capability, reader coverage, and boundary-provider search coverage, with the exact F0 distinctions and mutations named in the amendment. Unsupported is not Unexamined; NoCorrespondingSample is not Gap/OutsideDomain/NoCorrespondence; incomplete or failed/abstained/ineligible/unexamined empty search cannot construct ExaminedNoCandidate.

These repairs are finite and will be in the final superseding C1 sequence. No source, provider, runtime, dependency, codec, compiler, or implementation authority follows.
